event.old_custom_end.options.2.label.def.context: Event old_custom_end, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Ask for your freedom as the price.

event.old_custom_end.options.3.desc.defa.context: Event old_custom_end, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Turn victory into a step up the ladder.

event.old_custom_end.options.3.label.def.context: Event old_custom_end, authored option 3, label, branch default.

source.text: Ask instead for a place in the lord’s service.

event.old_custom_end.options.4.desc.defa.context: Event old_custom_end, authored option 4, desc, branch default.

source.text: Take what was offered and call it enough.

event.old_custom_end.options.4.label.def.context: Event old_custom_end, authored option 4, label, branch default.

source.text: Accept the narrow peace.

event.old_custom_end.options.5.desc.defa.context: Event old_custom_end, authored option 5, desc, branch default.

source.text: Coin seals what the bench left half-open.

event.old_custom_end.options.5.effects.l.context: Durable event log for old_custom_end, authored option 5, effects.

source.text: Bought confirmation of the household’s common rights.

event.old_custom_end.options.5.label.def.context: Event old_custom_end, authored option 5, label, branch default.

source.text: Pay for full confirmation. ({money:12})

event.old_custom_end.options.6.desc.defa.context: Event old_custom_end, authored option 6, desc, branch default.

source.text: Undo by night what was done by day — if unseen.

event.old_custom_end.options.6.failure.t.context: Event old_custom_end, authored option 6, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The reeve’s men are waiting among the trees.

event.old_custom_end.options.6.label.def.context: Event old_custom_end, authored option 6, label, branch default.

source.text: Pull the stakes down after dark.

event.old_custom_end.options.6.success.t.context: Event old_custom_end, authored option 6, success text, branch default.

source.text: By dawn no stake stands and no witness remembers a face. Use becomes custom once more.

event.old_custom_end.options.7.desc.defa.context: Event old_custom_end, authored option 7, desc, branch default.

source.text: Buy your way out of the judgment’s teeth.

event.old_custom_end.options.7.label.def.context: Event old_custom_end, authored option 7, label, branch default.

source.text: Pay the amercement. ({money:8})

event.old_custom_end.options.8.desc.defa.context: Event old_custom_end, authored option 8, desc, branch default.

source.text: One back bent so the village stands straight.

event.old_custom_end.options.8.label.def.context: Event old_custom_end, authored option 8, label, branch default.

source.text: Take the punishment for everyone.

event.old_custom_end.options.9.desc.defa.context: Event old_custom_end, authored option 9, desc, branch default.

source.text: Swallow defeat; grudges keep longer than grain.

event.old_custom_end.options.9.label.def.context: Event old_custom_end, authored option 9, label, branch default.

source.text: Endure the judgment and remember.

event.old_custom_end.text.default.context: Event old_custom_end, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The stakes, the hearing, and the names spoken there will be remembered. What matters now is what your household carries away.

event.old_custom_end.title.default.context: Event old_custom_end, title, faith branch default.

source.text: What Is Remembered

event.old_custom_hearing.options.0.desc..context: Event old_custom_hearing, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Win the hall with voices, or lose it to silence.

event.old_custom_hearing.options.0.failu.context: Event old_custom_hearing, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The steward calls it noise, not law. The reeve’s smile returns.

event.old_custom_hearing.options.0.label.context: Event old_custom_hearing, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: “Custom lives in those who keep it.”

event.old_custom_hearing.options.0.succe.context: Event old_custom_hearing, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: One witness follows another until even the steward must call the custom proven.

event.old_custom_hearing.options.1.desc..context: Event old_custom_hearing, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Let his own arithmetic betray him.

event.old_custom_hearing.options.1.failu.context: Event old_custom_hearing, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The steward finds three errors before you finish the first column.

event.old_custom_hearing.options.1.label.context: Event old_custom_hearing, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Lay out the rents, measures, and losses.

event.old_custom_hearing.options.1.succe.context: Event old_custom_hearing, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: The reeve’s demand contradicts his own accounts. The bench notices.

event.old_custom_hearing.options.2.desc..context: Event old_custom_hearing, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Old ink against new ambition.

event.old_custom_hearing.options.2.failu.context: Event old_custom_hearing, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The record speaks of another field, or perhaps another village. The case collapses in the reading.

event.old_custom_hearing.options.2.label.context: Event old_custom_hearing, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Read the oldest words you found.

event.old_custom_hearing.options.2.succe.context: Event old_custom_hearing, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: The old formula leaves little room to wriggle. The right is older than the reeve’s office.

event.old_custom_hearing.options.3.desc..context: Event old_custom_hearing, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Expose the thief — but slander cuts both ways.

event.old_custom_hearing.options.3.failu.context: Event old_custom_hearing, authored option 3, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The accusation lands as slander. The steward fines insolence as well as defeat.

event.old_custom_hearing.options.3.label.context: Event old_custom_hearing, authored option 3, label, branch default.

source.text: Prove that the reeve means to rob lord and village alike.

event.old_custom_hearing.options.3.succe.context: Event old_custom_hearing, authored option 3, success text, branch default.

source.text: A concealed tally and a frightened clerk do what righteous speeches could not.

event.old_custom_hearing.options.4.desc..context: Event old_custom_hearing, authored option 4, desc, branch default.

source.text: Purchase peace, and accept a smaller right.

event.old_custom_hearing.options.4.label.context: Event old_custom_hearing, authored option 4, label, branch default.

source.text: Buy a narrow settlement. ({money:10})

event.old_custom_hearing.options.5.desc..context: Event old_custom_hearing, authored option 5, desc, branch default.

source.text: Finish the betrayal you were paid to begin.

event.old_custom_hearing.options.5.label.context: Event old_custom_hearing, authored option 5, label, branch default.

source.text: Testify for the reeve.

event.old_custom_hearing.text.default.context: Event old_custom_hearing, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The households crowd the hall. The reeve has his tally and his men; you have whatever truth, skill, and favor you managed to gather.

event.old_custom_hearing.title.default.context: Event old_custom_hearing, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Before the Lord’s Bench

event.old_custom_memory.options.0.desc.d.context: Event old_custom_memory, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Oaths in chorus are heavy to lift against.

event.old_custom_memory.options.0.failur.context: Event old_custom_memory, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Two witnesses fall to shouting over whose grandfather owned which sow.

event.old_custom_memory.options.0.label..context: Event old_custom_memory, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Take sworn testimony from every hearth.

event.old_custom_memory.options.0.succes.context: Event old_custom_memory, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The stories agree where it matters. A village speaking together is difficult to dismiss.

event.old_custom_memory.options.1.desc.d.context: Event old_custom_memory, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Dust may yet yield what memory cannot.

event.old_custom_memory.options.1.failur.context: Event old_custom_memory, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The page that might have settled it was scraped clean generations ago.

event.old_custom_memory.options.1.label..context: Event old_custom_memory, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Search the old records again.

event.old_custom_memory.options.1.succes.context: Event old_custom_memory, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: In a faded hand: pasture, fallen wood, and water, reserved to the households in perpetuity.

event.old_custom_memory.options.2.desc.d.context: Event old_custom_memory, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: The land keeps its own record, if you can read it.

event.old_custom_memory.options.2.failur.context: Event old_custom_memory, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The forester finds you beyond the new stakes and reports the trespass.

event.old_custom_memory.options.2.label..context: Event old_custom_memory, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Walk the old boundary by night.

event.old_custom_memory.options.2.succes.context: Event old_custom_memory, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: Notches on trees and stones beneath the moss agree with the oldest memories.

event.old_custom_memory.options.3.desc.d.context: Event old_custom_memory, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Coin turns hearsay into parchment.

event.old_custom_memory.options.3.label..context: Event old_custom_memory, authored option 3, label, branch default.

source.text: Pay a clerk for a clean copy. ({money:8})

event.old_custom_memory.options.4.desc.d.context: Event old_custom_memory, authored option 4, desc, branch default.

source.text: A forged past is a dangerous foundation.

event.old_custom_memory.options.4.failur.context: Event old_custom_memory, authored option 4, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The clerk recognizes his predecessor’s hand — and knows this is not it.

event.old_custom_memory.options.4.label..context: Event old_custom_memory, authored option 4, label, branch default.

source.text: Write the missing custom yourself.

event.old_custom_memory.options.4.succes.context: Event old_custom_memory, authored option 4, success text, branch default.

source.text: Old ink, old phrasing, an old seal impressed again. It may be enough.

event.old_custom_memory.text.default.context: Event old_custom_memory, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Every elder remembers the boundary, but none remembers it quite alike. If custom is to stand before judgment, memory must become proof.

event.old_custom_memory.title.default.context: Event old_custom_memory, title, faith branch default.

source.text: What the Old Folk Remember

event.old_custom_reeve.options.0.desc.de.context: Event old_custom_reeve, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Refusal heard by many is hard to punish quietly.

event.old_custom_reeve.options.0.label.d.context: Event old_custom_reeve, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Reject his purse before witnesses.

event.old_custom_reeve.options.1.desc.de.context: Event old_custom_reeve, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Silver now; the village’s memory later.

event.old_custom_reeve.options.1.label.d.context: Event old_custom_reeve, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Take the purse and give him names.

event.old_custom_reeve.options.2.desc.de.context: Event old_custom_reeve, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Trap him into speaking his master’s secrets.

event.old_custom_reeve.options.2.failure.context: Event old_custom_reeve, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: He recognizes the trap and leaves smiling. The next threat will not be private.

event.old_custom_reeve.options.2.label.d.context: Event old_custom_reeve, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Make him reveal whose purse it truly is.

event.old_custom_reeve.options.2.success.context: Event old_custom_reeve, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: A feigned misunderstanding draws out the second tally — the one the lord has never seen.

event.old_custom_reeve.options.3.desc.de.context: Event old_custom_reeve, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Bruises seen by all accuse louder than words.

event.old_custom_reeve.options.3.failure.context: Event old_custom_reeve, authored option 3, failure text, branch default.

source.text: His men put you down hard, but they must do it where everyone can see.

event.old_custom_reeve.options.3.label.d.context: Event old_custom_reeve, authored option 3, label, branch default.

source.text: Make him use the stick in public.

event.old_custom_reeve.options.3.success.context: Event old_custom_reeve, authored option 3, success text, branch default.

source.text: You do not give ground. By morning every bruise in the village belongs to your cause.

event.old_custom_reeve.options.4.desc.de.context: Event old_custom_reeve, authored option 4, desc, branch default.

source.text: Appeal over the dog to the hand that feeds it.

event.old_custom_reeve.options.4.label.d.context: Event old_custom_reeve, authored option 4, label, branch default.

source.text: Ask {lord} to examine his own reeve.

event.old_custom_reeve.options.5.desc.de.context: Event old_custom_reeve, authored option 5, desc, branch default.

source.text: Call in the favor heaven owes you.

event.old_custom_reeve.options.5.label.d.context: Event old_custom_reeve, authored option 5, label, branch default.

source.text: Ask {priest} to stand as protector. (5 piety)

event.old_custom_reeve.text.default.context: Event old_custom_reeve, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The reeve comes without his men. First he offers a purse. Then he explains, very softly, what refusal may cost.

event.old_custom_reeve.title.default.context: Event old_custom_reeve, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Reeve Comes at Dusk

event.old_custom_stakes.options.0.desc.d.context: Event old_custom_stakes, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: One voice carries further than forty quarrels.

event.old_custom_stakes.options.0.failur.context: Event old_custom_stakes, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Old grudges prove stronger than old custom. Half the village will not stand beside the other half.

event.old_custom_stakes.options.0.label..context: Event old_custom_stakes, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Call every household together.

event.old_custom_stakes.options.0.succes.context: Event old_custom_stakes, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Quarrels are put aside. One by one, the households agree to speak with a single voice.

event.old_custom_stakes.options.1.desc.d.context: Event old_custom_stakes, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Grief argued in numbers is harder to dismiss.

event.old_custom_stakes.options.1.failur.context: Event old_custom_stakes, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The strips, ditches, and remembered bounds refuse to add up cleanly.

event.old_custom_stakes.options.1.label..context: Event old_custom_stakes, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Measure exactly what is being taken.

event.old_custom_stakes.options.1.succes.context: Event old_custom_stakes, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: Paces, rents, beasts, winter fuel — you put a number to every loss.

event.old_custom_stakes.options.2.desc.d.context: Event old_custom_stakes, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Somewhere, ink remembers what men deny.

event.old_custom_stakes.options.2.failur.context: Event old_custom_stakes, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Dust, worm-holes, and pious accounts — but no grant anyone can use.

event.old_custom_stakes.options.2.label..context: Event old_custom_stakes, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Find words older than the reeve.

event.old_custom_stakes.options.2.succes.context: Event old_custom_stakes, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: A neglected record speaks of pasture and fuel owed to every hearth.

event.old_custom_stakes.options.3.desc.d.context: Event old_custom_stakes, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Sell your neighbors’ names and see what coin buys.

event.old_custom_stakes.options.3.failur.context: Event old_custom_stakes, authored option 3, failure text, branch default.

source.text: He takes the names, keeps his coin, and looks at you with contempt.

event.old_custom_stakes.options.3.label..context: Event old_custom_stakes, authored option 3, label, branch default.

source.text: Tell the reeve who is stirring trouble.

event.old_custom_stakes.options.3.succes.context: Event old_custom_stakes, authored option 3, success text, branch default.

source.text: The reeve pays for names and promises to remember yours kindly.

event.old_custom_stakes.text.default.context: Event old_custom_stakes, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Fresh stakes stand across the waste where the households of {province} have grazed beasts, cut fuel, and drawn water since anyone remembers. The reeve says it is the lord’s land, and tomorrow it will be closed.

event.old_custom_stakes.title.default.context: Event old_custom_stakes, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Stakes in the Common

event.parliament_aid_hike.options.0.desc.context: Event parliament_aid_hike, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: First voice for the crown buys the crown’s notice.

event.parliament_aid_hike.options.0.labe.context: Event parliament_aid_hike, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Rise and consent at once.

event.parliament_aid_hike.options.1.desc.context: Event parliament_aid_hike, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The lords vote — your voice carries as far as your rank and name.

event.parliament_aid_hike.options.1.fail.context: Event parliament_aid_hike, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Too many lords owe the crown favors, or fear it. The aid is voted through, and the liege’s cut of your revenue grows.

event.parliament_aid_hike.options.1.labe.context: Event parliament_aid_hike, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Put it to the estates.

event.parliament_aid_hike.options.1.succ.context: Event parliament_aid_hike, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: Lord by lord, the benches shake their heads. The steward folds his tally. The demand dies in the hall — and the liege marks who led the “no.”

event.parliament_aid_hike.options.2.desc.context: Event parliament_aid_hike, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Defiance is remembered — in both directions.

event.parliament_aid_hike.options.2.labe.context: Event parliament_aid_hike, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Refuse to your feet, alone if need be.

event.parliament_aid_hike.text.default.context: Event parliament_aid_hike, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The hall is full and the mood is sour before the first word: {liege}’s steward reads the demand twice over — a greater aid from every vassal, a heavier cut of every rent and toll, “for the good of the realm.” The benches turn to look at the men who will answer first. One of them is you.

event.parliament_aid_hike.title.default.context: Event parliament_aid_hike, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Liege Demands an Aid

event.parliament_grievance.options.0.des.context: Event parliament_grievance, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: The estates remember who shows courage — and so does the crown.

event.parliament_grievance.options.0.fai.context: Event parliament_grievance, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The hall is not with you today. The old lord’s suit fails, and you have spent favor on a losing cause.

event.parliament_grievance.options.0.lab.context: Event parliament_grievance, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Stand with him when he rises.

event.parliament_grievance.options.0.suc.context: Event parliament_grievance, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Your seconding carries the hall; the old lord wins his judgment and grips your hand till it hurts. The liege’s clerks write something down.

event.parliament_grievance.options.1.des.context: Event parliament_grievance, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Another man’s quarrel, another man’s risk.

event.parliament_grievance.options.1.lab.context: Event parliament_grievance, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Murmur sympathy, and drift away.

event.parliament_grievance.text.default.context: Event parliament_grievance, text, faith branch default.

source.text: In the recess, a hoarse old lord corners you by the wine: his grandson’s inheritance was shaved by {liege}’s courts, and he means to stand up in the hall and say so. He wants voices beside his — yours, loudly. The liege’s clerks are watching who nods.

event.parliament_grievance.title.default.context: Event parliament_grievance, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Fellow Lord’s Grievance

event.parliament_redress.options.0.desc..context: Event parliament_redress, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: The estates decide — rank, name, and the liege’s favor all count now.

event.parliament_redress.options.0.failu.context: Event parliament_redress, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The hands stay down. Your motion dies in a long silence, and the liege’s smile finds you across the hall.

event.parliament_redress.options.0.label.context: Event parliament_redress, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Press the motion to a vote.

event.parliament_redress.options.0.succe.context: Durable event log for parliament_redress, authored option 0, success.effects.

source.text: Won redress of grievances in the estates.

event.parliament_redress.options.0.succe.context: Event parliament_redress, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: It carries — first by voices, then by a show of hands the steward cannot ignore. The aid falls. The liege inclines his head to you with great courtesy, which costs him nothing and promises nothing good.

event.parliament_redress.options.1.desc..context: Event parliament_redress, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Some motions serve better as threats than as votes.

event.parliament_redress.options.1.label.context: Event parliament_redress, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Let it be talked out, and withdraw.

event.parliament_redress.text.default.context: Event parliament_redress, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Your own parchment is read to the assembled lords: a motion for redress of grievances — that the aid exacted by {liege} is heavier than custom allows, and should be lowered. The benches murmur. The liege’s face gives nothing away, which says everything.

event.parliament_redress.title.default.context: Event parliament_redress, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Motion for Redress

event.parliament_scutage.options.0.desc..context: Event parliament_scutage, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: The crown will want its pound in coin — a small standing rise in the aid.

event.parliament_scutage.options.0.failu.context: Event parliament_scutage, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The war-hungry lords shout it down: what is a vassal without his spear? The liege looks pleased, and looks at you.

event.parliament_scutage.options.0.label.context: Event parliament_scutage, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Press the motion to a vote.

event.parliament_scutage.options.0.succe.context: Durable event log for parliament_scutage, authored option 0, success.effects.

source.text: Carried a scutage motion in the estates.

event.parliament_scutage.options.0.succe.context: Event parliament_scutage, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The motion carries, to the relief of every manor with a leaking hall. Henceforth the liege’s summons can be answered with a purse — and the aid creeps up to pay for the privilege.

event.parliament_scutage.options.1.desc..context: Event parliament_scutage, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: A poor season for it. Another year, perhaps.

event.parliament_scutage.options.1.label.context: Event parliament_scutage, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Let it be talked out, and withdraw.

event.parliament_scutage.text.default.context: Event parliament_scutage, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Your motion before the estates: that the lords of the realm may answer {liege}’s banner call with silver instead of service — scutage, the shield-tax, as the old charters name it. The young lords who love a campaign scoff; the old ones with roofs to mend lean forward.

event.parliament_scutage.title.default.context: Event parliament_scutage, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Motion for Scutage

event.parliament_session.options.0.desc..context: Event parliament_session, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A kind word here, a promised favor there — court craft in miniature.

event.parliament_session.options.0.failu.context: Event parliament_session, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: You mistake a proud old lord for a petitioner and compound it with a joke. A few smiles, poorly hidden.

event.parliament_session.options.0.label.context: Event parliament_session, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Work the benches.

event.parliament_session.options.0.succe.context: Event parliament_session, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: You leave the hall with three new friends and a standing invitation. Your name is warming in the realm.

event.parliament_session.options.1.desc..context: Event parliament_session, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: How the great ones argue, flatter, and threaten — a free education.

event.parliament_session.options.1.label.context: Event parliament_session, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Listen and take notes.

event.parliament_session.options.2.desc..context: Event parliament_session, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: The unremarked lord keeps what he has.

event.parliament_session.options.2.label.context: Event parliament_session, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Sit quiet and keep your head down.

event.parliament_session.text.default.context: Event parliament_session, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The lords of the realm gather at {liege}’s summons: petty business mostly — a boundary dispute, a widow’s dower, a reading of old charters — but every bench is a pair of ears, and every recess a market of favors.

event.parliament_session.title.default.context: Event parliament_session, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Estates Assemble

event.parliament_subsidy.options.0.desc..context: Event parliament_subsidy, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: The crown’s gratitude, on the record.

event.parliament_subsidy.options.0.label.context: Event parliament_subsidy, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Vote the subsidy, and give generously. ({money:20})

event.parliament_subsidy.options.1.desc..context: Event parliament_subsidy, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Wars are the lord’s affair — let the lord’s treasure pay for them.

event.parliament_subsidy.options.1.label.context: Event parliament_subsidy, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Speak against it.

event.parliament_subsidy.text.default.context: Event parliament_subsidy, text, faith branch default.

source.text: War has emptied {liege}’s coffers, and the estates are summoned to refill them: a subsidy, voted lord by lord, “for the defense of the realm.” The steward’s clerk has already written your name on the roll, with a space beside it for a number.

event.parliament_subsidy.title.default.context: Event parliament_subsidy, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Subsidy for the Liege’s War

event.partner_offer.options.0.desc.defau.context: Event partner_offer, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: His markets could pay richly — or swallow your stake.

event.partner_offer.options.0.failure.te.context: Event partner_offer, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The letters stop coming. So does the money.

event.partner_offer.options.0.label.defa.context: Event partner_offer, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Shake on it. (risk {money:15})

event.partner_offer.options.0.success.te.context: Event partner_offer, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: His letters prove good as gold. The partnership pays handsomely.

event.partner_offer.options.1.desc.defau.context: Event partner_offer, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: No coin risked; knowledge travels both ways.

event.partner_offer.options.1.label.defa.context: Event partner_offer, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Trade information only.

event.partner_offer.options.2.desc.defau.context: Event partner_offer, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Suspicious silk is cheap to refuse.

event.partner_offer.options.2.label.defa.context: Event partner_offer, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Decline politely.

event.partner_offer.text.default.context: Event partner_offer, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A foreign merchant — silk cuffs, careful eyes — proposes a joint venture: your local knowledge, his distant markets.

event.partner_offer.title.default.context: Event partner_offer, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Partner from Far Off

event.peasant_revolt.options.0.desc.defa.context: Event peasant_revolt, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Iron ends rebellions — or feeds them martyrs.

event.peasant_revolt.options.0.failure.t.context: Event peasant_revolt, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Pitchforks in the dark defeat proud steel. You flee your own lands for a season, humiliated.

event.peasant_revolt.options.0.label.def.context: Event peasant_revolt, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Crush them with steel.

event.peasant_revolt.options.0.success.e.context: Durable event log for peasant_revolt, authored option 0, success.effects.

source.text: Crushed a peasant revolt.

event.peasant_revolt.options.0.success.t.context: Event peasant_revolt, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The revolt breaks against your armed men. The Ploughman King hangs at the crossroads.

event.peasant_revolt.options.1.desc.defa.context: Event peasant_revolt, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: A listening lord risks being thought a weak one.

event.peasant_revolt.options.1.failure.t.context: Event peasant_revolt, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: They take patience for weakness and demand more, emboldened.

event.peasant_revolt.options.1.label.def.context: Event peasant_revolt, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Hear their grievances.

event.peasant_revolt.options.1.success.e.context: Durable event log for peasant_revolt, authored option 1, success.effects.

source.text: Settled a revolt with mercy.

event.peasant_revolt.options.1.success.t.context: Event peasant_revolt, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: You remit the worst taxes; the crowd disperses, grudging but calm. Wise lords bend.

event.peasant_revolt.text.default.context: Event peasant_revolt, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Torches in the night. Your taxmen beaten, your granary seized — the peasants of {province} have risen, led by a man they call the Ploughman King.

event.peasant_revolt.title.default.context: Event peasant_revolt, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Commons Rise

event.peddler_knock.options.0.desc.defau.context: Event peddler_knock, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Unusual things find unusual owners.

event.peddler_knock.options.0.label.defa.context: Event peddler_knock, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: See what he carries.

event.peddler_knock.options.1.desc.defau.context: Event peddler_knock, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Curiosity is cheap; its prizes are not.

event.peddler_knock.options.1.label.defa.context: Event peddler_knock, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Send him on his way.

event.peddler_knock.text.default.context: Event peddler_knock, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A peddler with a guarded pack and quick eyes asks, very quietly, after “a buyer of unusual things.”

event.peddler_knock.title.default.context: Event peddler_knock, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Peddler’s Pack

event.pestilence_arrives.options.0.desc..context: Event pestilence_arrives, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: There is little to do now but bar the door and pray.

event.pestilence_arrives.options.0.effec.context: Durable event log for pestilence_arrives, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Pestilence reached {province}.

event.pestilence_arrives.options.0.label.context: Event pestilence_arrives, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: {god} preserve us.

event.pestilence_arrives.text.default.context: Event pestilence_arrives, text, faith branch default.

source.text: It came with the traders, they say. First the fever, then the marks, then the bells. The pestilence has reached {province}.

event.pestilence_arrives.text.muslim.context: Event pestilence_arrives, text, faith branch muslim.

source.text: It came with the traders, they say. First the fever, then the marks, then the wailing. The pestilence has reached {province}.

event.pestilence_arrives.text.pagan.context: Event pestilence_arrives, text, faith branch pagan.

source.text: It came with the traders, they say. First the fever, then the marks, then the pyres. The pestilence has reached {province}.

event.pestilence_arrives.title.default.context: Event pestilence_arrives, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Pestilence

event.pestilence_ends.options.0.desc.def.context: Event pestilence_ends, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Count the living and begin again.

event.pestilence_ends.options.0.effects..context: Durable event log for pestilence_ends, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: The pestilence ended.

event.pestilence_ends.options.0.label.de.context: Event pestilence_ends, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: It is over.

event.pestilence_ends.text.default.context: Event pestilence_ends, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A season passes with no new graves. Thin, wary, the survivors of {province} step into the sun and count who remains.

event.pestilence_ends.title.default.context: Event pestilence_ends, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Bells Fall Silent

event.pestilence_rages.options.0.desc.de.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Hide from the sickness and hope it passes your door.

event.pestilence_rages.options.0.failure.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: It finds a crack. The fever takes you.

event.pestilence_rages.options.0.label.d.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Shut your household away.

event.pestilence_rages.options.0.success.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The sickness passes your door.

event.pestilence_rages.options.1.desc.de.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The village will remember — if the fever does not claim you too.

event.pestilence_rages.options.1.failure.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The dead share their sickness with the living.

event.pestilence_rages.options.1.label.d.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Help bury the dead.

event.pestilence_rages.options.1.success.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: Grim work, holy work. The village will not forget.

event.pestilence_rages.options.2.desc.de.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Somewhere the bells are not ringing. Perhaps.

event.pestilence_rages.options.2.effects.context: Durable event log for pestilence_rages, authored option 2, effects.

source.text: Fled the pestilence.

event.pestilence_rages.options.2.label.d.context: Event pestilence_rages, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Flee to another province.

event.pestilence_rages.text.default.context: Event pestilence_rages, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Carts in the lanes, lime on the doors. Every family has a grave to dig; some have no one left to dig it.

event.pestilence_rages.title.default.context: Event pestilence_rages, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Dying Time

event.player_comes_of_age.options.0.desc.context: Event player_comes_of_age, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Sweat is the surest inheritance.

event.player_comes_of_age.options.0.labe.context: Event player_comes_of_age, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: The value of hard work.

event.player_comes_of_age.options.1.desc.context: Event player_comes_of_age, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Steel answers what words cannot.

event.player_comes_of_age.options.1.labe.context: Event player_comes_of_age, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: How to handle a blade.

event.player_comes_of_age.options.2.desc.context: Event player_comes_of_age, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: A literate mind is a quiet weapon.

event.player_comes_of_age.options.2.labe.context: Event player_comes_of_age, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Letters and numbers.

event.player_comes_of_age.options.3.desc.context: Event player_comes_of_age, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Know men, and you need fear few of them.

event.player_comes_of_age.options.3.labe.context: Event player_comes_of_age, authored option 3, label, branch default.

source.text: How to read people.

event.player_comes_of_age.text.default.context: Event player_comes_of_age, text, faith branch default.

source.text: You are sixteen — grown, in the eyes of {god} and the law. No tutor shaped your years, so what has your family’s household taught you best?

event.player_comes_of_age.title.default.context: Event player_comes_of_age, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Coming of Age

event.player_educated.options.0.desc.def.context: Event player_educated, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: The lessons are yours to spend now.

event.player_educated.options.0.label.de.context: Event player_educated, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: I will do the family proud.

event.player_educated.options.1.desc.def.context: Event player_educated, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The world is the last and hardest tutor.

event.player_educated.options.1.label.de.context: Event player_educated, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Now my true education begins.

event.player_educated.text.default.context: Event player_educated, text, faith branch default.

source.text: You turn sixteen. The years of lessons are over — whatever your teachers drilled into you, for good or ill, is yours to carry now.

event.player_educated.title.default.context: Event player_educated, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Lessons End

event.plot_court_whispers.options.0.desc.context: Event plot_court_whispers, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: One whisper, if it lands, reshapes the hall.

event.plot_court_whispers.options.0.fail.context: Event plot_court_whispers, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The whisper is traced back along the chain of mouths — to yours.

event.plot_court_whispers.options.0.labe.context: Event plot_court_whispers, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Speak the word.

event.plot_court_whispers.options.0.succ.context: Event plot_court_whispers, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Your obstacle leaves court under a cloud, and his place in the lord’s regard falls quietly to you.

event.plot_court_whispers.options.1.desc.context: Event plot_court_whispers, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Unspoken words can never be traced.

event.plot_court_whispers.options.1.labe.context: Event plot_court_whispers, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Swallow it.

event.plot_court_whispers.text.default.context: Event plot_court_whispers, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Months of patience have shaped the hall’s opinion the way water shapes stone. One final whisper will finish it.

event.plot_court_whispers.title.default.context: Event plot_court_whispers, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Word in the Right Ear

event.plot_discovered.options.0.desc.def.context: Event plot_discovered, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Cut every thread and swear there never was a web.

event.plot_discovered.options.0.label.de.context: Event plot_discovered, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Abandon everything. Deny everything.

event.plot_discovered.options.1.desc.def.context: Event plot_discovered, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Strike half-ready, and pray speed makes up for it.

event.plot_discovered.options.1.failure..context: Event plot_discovered, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Half-ready is not ready. The whole scheme collapses on your head in daylight.

event.plot_discovered.options.1.label.de.context: Event plot_discovered, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Rush the final stroke NOW.

event.plot_discovered.options.1.success..context: Event plot_discovered, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: Half-ready proves ready enough — barely. What you sought, you seize, and the talkers fall silent.

event.plot_discovered.text.default.context: Event plot_discovered, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Someone has talked. Conversations die when you approach; eyes follow you out of rooms. The plot is known — or nearly.

event.plot_discovered.title.default.context: Event plot_discovered, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Web Trembles

event.plot_fabricate_claim.options.0.des.context: Event plot_fabricate_claim, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Intrigue, learning, and renown must carry a document older-looking than it is.

event.plot_fabricate_claim.options.0.fai.context: Event plot_fabricate_claim, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: A witness changes his story. The seals are named false, and the charter is torn in open court.

event.plot_fabricate_claim.options.0.lab.context: Event plot_fabricate_claim, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Present the charter.

event.plot_fabricate_claim.options.0.suc.context: Durable event log for plot_fabricate_claim, authored option 0, success.effects.

source.text: Fabricated a claim to {cname}.

event.plot_fabricate_claim.options.0.suc.context: Event plot_fabricate_claim, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The objections tangle and fail. Your right to {cname} is entered into the rolls.

event.plot_fabricate_claim.options.1.des.context: Event plot_fabricate_claim, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Abandon the scheme without testing the lie.

event.plot_fabricate_claim.options.1.lab.context: Event plot_fabricate_claim, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Burn it before anyone reads it.

event.plot_fabricate_claim.text.default.context: Event plot_fabricate_claim, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The ink is dry, the seals are warm, and three well-paid witnesses remember that {cname} belonged to your forebears. Only the final recital before the court remains.

event.plot_fabricate_claim.title.default.context: Event plot_fabricate_claim, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Charter from the Dust

event.plot_locked_chest.options.0.desc.d.context: Event plot_locked_chest, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: One careful hour against the dog’s memory.

event.plot_locked_chest.options.0.failur.context: Event plot_locked_chest, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The dog remembered its duty after all. You go over the wall torn, and known.

event.plot_locked_chest.options.0.label..context: Event plot_locked_chest, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Crack it.

event.plot_locked_chest.options.0.succes.context: Event plot_locked_chest, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Coin — and a bundle wrapped in wool. Whether it holds anything your family lacks remains to be seen.

event.plot_locked_chest.options.1.desc.d.context: Event plot_locked_chest, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Some chests are best left singing.

event.plot_locked_chest.options.1.label..context: Event plot_locked_chest, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Leave it be.

event.plot_locked_chest.text.default.context: Event plot_locked_chest, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The household sleeps; the dog knows you now. The chest waits where the steward believes nobody knows.

event.plot_locked_chest.title.default.context: Event plot_locked_chest, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Chest Sings

event.plot_ruin_rival.options.0.desc.def.context: Event plot_ruin_rival, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: One word, and {rival} falls — if the web holds.

event.plot_ruin_rival.options.0.failure..context: Event plot_ruin_rival, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: A thread snaps — a bought man sells you back. The whole village knows whose hand held the knife.

event.plot_ruin_rival.options.0.label.de.context: Event plot_ruin_rival, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Spring the trap.

event.plot_ruin_rival.options.0.success..context: Durable event log for plot_ruin_rival, authored option 0, success.effects.

source.text: Brought a rival low by intrigue.

event.plot_ruin_rival.options.0.success..context: Event plot_ruin_rival, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Debts, rumors, and old friends turn all at once. {rival} is ruined — everyone suspects you, and no one can prove it.

event.plot_ruin_rival.options.1.desc.def.context: Event plot_ruin_rival, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: A sprung trap can catch the hunter.

event.plot_ruin_rival.options.1.label.de.context: Event plot_ruin_rival, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Let it go. Mercy — or nerves.

event.plot_ruin_rival.text.default.context: Event plot_ruin_rival, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Every thread is in place and {rival} suspects nothing. One word from you and the web draws tight.

event.plot_ruin_rival.title.default.context: Event plot_ruin_rival, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Trap Closes

event.plot_skim_taxes.options.0.desc.def.context: Event plot_skim_taxes, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: The difference is yours — if no clerk looks twice.

event.plot_skim_taxes.options.0.failure..context: Event plot_skim_taxes, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: An honest clerk — the rarest hazard. The liege’s displeasure arrives with an audit.

event.plot_skim_taxes.options.0.label.de.context: Event plot_skim_taxes, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Send the false count.

event.plot_skim_taxes.options.0.success..context: Event plot_skim_taxes, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The liege’s clerks stamp it without a second glance. The difference is yours, this year and after.

event.plot_skim_taxes.options.1.desc.def.context: Event plot_skim_taxes, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Ashes make poor evidence.

event.plot_skim_taxes.options.1.label.de.context: Event plot_skim_taxes, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Burn the false ledger.

event.plot_skim_taxes.text.default.context: Event plot_skim_taxes, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The false ledger is perfect — every hide and hearth accounted for, and a fifth of it quietly missing.

event.plot_skim_taxes.title.default.context: Event plot_skim_taxes, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Two Sets of Books

event.plot_spouse_end.options.0.desc.def.context: Event plot_spouse_end, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: One nod, and the house mourns on cue.

event.plot_spouse_end.options.0.failure..context: Event plot_spouse_end, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The cup is knocked aside — {spouse} reads your face and knows. What lives in your house now is not a marriage but a watch.

event.plot_spouse_end.options.0.label.de.context: Event plot_spouse_end, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Give the word.

event.plot_spouse_end.options.0.success..context: Durable event log for plot_spouse_end, authored option 0, success.effects.

source.text: Was widowed — suddenly, conveniently.

event.plot_spouse_end.options.0.success..context: Event plot_spouse_end, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: A sudden illness, the neighbors say. The house mourns, and none mourn louder than you.

event.plot_spouse_end.options.1.desc.def.context: Event plot_spouse_end, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Some doors, once opened, never close.

event.plot_spouse_end.options.1.effects..context: Durable event log for plot_spouse_end, authored option 1, effects.

source.text: Abandoned a dark design.

event.plot_spouse_end.options.1.label.de.context: Event plot_spouse_end, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Stay your hand.

event.plot_spouse_end.text.default.context: Event plot_spouse_end, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Everything is in place: the draught measured, the stair loosened, the witnesses elsewhere. {spouse} suspects nothing. One nod from you and it is done.

event.plot_spouse_end.title.default.context: Event plot_spouse_end, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Cup Is Poured

event.plot_tithe_barn.options.0.desc.def.context: Event plot_tithe_barn, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: One night’s nerve against a winter’s hunger.

event.plot_tithe_barn.options.0.failure..context: Event plot_tithe_barn, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: A new watchman, unbought. You run for the trees and leave your good name behind.

event.plot_tithe_barn.options.0.label.de.context: Event plot_tithe_barn, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Take the grain.

event.plot_tithe_barn.options.0.success..context: Event plot_tithe_barn, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: By dawn the sacks are hidden and the ledger is none the wiser. Winter holds no fear this year.

event.plot_tithe_barn.options.1.desc.def.context: Event plot_tithe_barn, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Stolen bread is never quite free.

event.plot_tithe_barn.options.1.label.de.context: Event plot_tithe_barn, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Walk away from it.

event.plot_tithe_barn.text.default.context: Event plot_tithe_barn, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The watchman is bought, the dogs are fed, and the cart waits in the alder grove. Tonight the lord’s plenty can become yours.

event.plot_tithe_barn.title.default.context: Event plot_tithe_barn, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Barn at Midnight

event.poetry_quarrel.options.0.desc.defa.context: Event poetry_quarrel, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A keen reply could shame him — or you.

event.poetry_quarrel.options.0.failure.t.context: Event poetry_quarrel, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: You stumble on the meter. The laughter is not with you.

event.poetry_quarrel.options.0.label.def.context: Event poetry_quarrel, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Answer with sharper verses of your own.

event.poetry_quarrel.options.0.success.t.context: Event poetry_quarrel, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Your reply cuts twice as deep. The gathering roars; his shame will outlive him.

event.poetry_quarrel.options.1.desc.defa.context: Event poetry_quarrel, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Some insults die faster than feuds.

event.poetry_quarrel.options.1.label.def.context: Event poetry_quarrel, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Smile and let the verses die.

event.poetry_quarrel.options.2.desc.defa.context: Event poetry_quarrel, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Simpler than verse, and bloodier to lose.

event.poetry_quarrel.options.2.failure.t.context: Event poetry_quarrel, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: His friends pull you apart — after the worst of it.

event.poetry_quarrel.options.2.label.def.context: Event poetry_quarrel, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Answer with your fists.

event.poetry_quarrel.options.2.success.t.context: Event poetry_quarrel, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: Poetry has its place; so does a good grip. He recants, wheezing.

event.poetry_quarrel.text.default.context: Event poetry_quarrel, text, faith branch default.

source.text: At the evening majlis a braggart recites verses mocking your family — polished, cruel, and already being repeated with delight.

event.poetry_quarrel.title.default.context: Event poetry_quarrel, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Duel of Verses

event.polly_arms.options.0.desc.default.context: Event polly_arms, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A keen blade close at hand is worth more than the coppers it costs.

event.polly_arms.options.0.label.default.context: Event polly_arms, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Take a good fighting knife from the cart.

event.polly_arms.options.1.desc.default.context: Event polly_arms, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: It will not stop a lance, but it has turned many a tired sword.

event.polly_arms.options.1.label.default.context: Event polly_arms, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Take a padded jack for your back and ribs.

event.polly_arms.options.2.desc.default.context: Event polly_arms, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Coin keeps; borrowed iron does not. Travel light.

event.polly_arms.options.2.label.default.context: Event polly_arms, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Pocket every coin and trust your spear.

event.polly_arms.text.default.context: Event polly_arms, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Before a war is fought it must be paid for. The paymaster counts thin coins into every calloused palm — your first soldier’s wage, earned as a man — and the quartermaster’s cart stands open beside him: dented iron and stiff leather for anyone who came without their own. Kit yourself now; tomorrow the column turns toward the enemy.

event.polly_arms.title.default.context: Event polly_arms, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Paymaster’s Table

event.polly_battle.options.0.desc.defaul.context: Event polly_battle, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Glory and grave both live in the shield-wall. Stand.

event.polly_battle.options.0.failure.tex.context: Event polly_battle, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The wall buckles where you least expect it. A blow you never see punches the wind and the sense clean out of you, and the rout washes over you like cold black water.

event.polly_battle.options.0.label.defau.context: Event polly_battle, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Set your feet and hold the line.

event.polly_battle.options.0.success.eff.context: Durable event log for polly_battle, authored option 0, success.effects.

source.text: Held the shield-wall and lived.

event.polly_battle.options.0.success.tex.context: Event polly_battle, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The world shrinks to the man in front of you — and then he is down, and their wall breaks and runs, and you are alive, shaking, splashed to the elbow, and alive. The field and its dead lie open for the looting.

event.polly_battle.options.1.desc.defaul.context: Event polly_battle, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: If you fall, fall at his shoulder. Reckless — and human.

event.polly_battle.options.1.failure.tex.context: Event polly_battle, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: You never reach him. The line folds first, and a spear-butt or a boot-heel — you will never know which — drops you into the churned mud as the rout howls past overhead.

event.polly_battle.options.1.label.defau.context: Event polly_battle, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Fight your way along the line to {suitor}.

event.polly_battle.options.1.success.eff.context: Durable event log for polly_battle, authored option 1, success.effects.

source.text: Cut her way to her beloved’s shoulder and held.

event.polly_battle.options.1.success.tex.context: Event polly_battle, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: You carve sideways through the press and plant yourself at his shoulder, a nameless recruit who fights like something loosed from a cage. Back to back you hold until the enemy breaks — and he stares at you as a man stares at a face he half-remembers from a dream.

event.polly_battle.text.default.context: Event polly_battle, text, faith branch default.

source.text: It is nothing like the drill-yard. The line locks shield to shield, the horns wail, and across a hundred paces of trampled barley the enemy comes on like a grey tide. Somewhere down the wall is {suitor}, white-knuckled on his spear. There is no hiding left now — only the wall, and whether you hold your span of it.

event.polly_battle.title.default.context: Event polly_battle, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Shield-Wall

event.polly_drill.options.0.desc.default.context: Event polly_drill, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Sweat now, live later — and grow strong enough to matter.

event.polly_drill.options.0.label.defaul.context: Event polly_drill, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Throw yourself into the training.

event.polly_drill.options.1.desc.default.context: Event polly_drill, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Bathe alone, sleep in your shirt, trust no one. Caution over glory.

event.polly_drill.options.1.label.defaul.context: Event polly_drill, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Guard the secret above all else.

event.polly_drill.options.2.desc.default.context: Event polly_drill, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Comrades who love you look less closely at you.

event.polly_drill.options.2.failure.text.context: Event polly_drill, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: You fumble a verse every farm boy has known since the cradle, and a one-eyed veteran squints at you a beat too long before he lets it pass.

event.polly_drill.options.2.label.defaul.context: Event polly_drill, authored option 2, label, branch default.

event.polly_drill.options.2.success.text.context: Event polly_drill, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: You stand a round with your last coppers and bawl the filthy marching songs louder than any. They call you a good lad and mean it — and a good lad is never questioned.

event.polly_drill.text.default.context: Event polly_drill, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Days blur into blisters and bruises. The serjeant’s stick finds every dropped shield, and the men wash and boast and sprawl with no thought for the slight recruit who always slips off alone. Your arms harden; the spear stops feeling like a stranger in your hands. And once, across the cook-fire, {suitor} passes you the bread without a second glance — and your treacherous heart nearly betrays you where the serjeant’s eye never could.

event.polly_enlist.options.0.label.defau.context: Event polly_enlist, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.polly_enlist.options.1.desc.defaul.context: Event polly_enlist, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Learn by watching; draw no eyes to a jaw too smooth.

event.polly_enlist.options.1.label.defau.context: Event polly_enlist, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Keep to the edges and copy the veterans.

event.polly_enlist.text.default.context: Event polly_enlist, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The shears bite; your braid coils on the barn floor and you are someone else. Chest bound flat under a dead brother’s shirt, voice pitched low, a man’s name ready on your tongue, you fall in at the tail of the column. Ahead in the ranks — close enough to see, too close to be safe — marches {suitor}, who does not know you from any other raw recruit.

event.polly_enlist.title.default.context: Event polly_enlist, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Braid on the Barn Floor

event.polly_farewell.options.0.desc.defa.context: Event polly_farewell, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Bind your chest, take a man’s name, and march. Madness — or the only road left.

event.polly_farewell.options.0.effects.l.context: Durable event log for polly_farewell, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Cut off her braid and followed the muster to war.

event.polly_farewell.options.0.label.def.context: Event polly_farewell, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.polly_farewell.options.1.desc.defa.context: Event polly_farewell, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Some things are not to be. Swallow it, and stay who you are.

event.polly_farewell.options.1.label.def.context: Event polly_farewell, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Watch the dust settle, and let him go.

event.polly_farewell.text.default.context: Event polly_farewell, text, faith branch default.

source.text: There is a young man of the next holding — quick to laugh, quicker to blush — and you had half a mind to make him yours. But the war has swallowed the season: the lord’s serjeants are taking every unwed man who can hold a spear, and this morning he stands in the muster line with a borrowed shield on his arm and no notion that you exist. By dusk the company will be a smudge of dust on the war road, and him with it. A woman does not follow an army. Everyone knows that.

source.text: Wed the soldier she followed to war.

event.polly_reunion.options.0.label.defa.context: Event polly_reunion, authored option 0, label, branch default.

event.polly_reunion.options.1.desc.defau.context: Event polly_reunion, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Spurned her sweetheart and marched home her own woman.

event.polly_reunion.options.1.label.defa.context: Event polly_reunion, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: “I crossed a war to find you — and found I like myself better.”

event.polly_reunion.options.2.desc.defau.context: Event polly_reunion, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Let him wonder to his grave who that soldier was. Keep the tale for yourself.

event.polly_reunion.options.2.effects.lo.context: Durable event log for polly_reunion, authored option 2, effects.

source.text: Vanished from the field a stranger, and went home to her own life.

event.polly_reunion.options.2.label.defa.context: Event polly_reunion, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Pull the helm back on and slip away a stranger.

event.polly_reunion.text.default.context: Event polly_reunion, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The fighting is done and the crows have come down to their work. Battered or triumphant, you find {suitor} among the living — and when you drag the helm off your cropped head and speak in your own true voice at last, he goes white, then red, then utterly and gratifyingly speechless. A year of blisters and terror and midnight fear, all for this face gaping at you like a fish just landed.

event.polly_reunion.text.muslim.context: Event polly_reunion, text, faith branch muslim.

A year of blisters and terror and midnight fear, all for this face gaping at you like a fish just landed. Let the poets make of it what they will; they have sung of stranger women under armor.

event.rival_legacy.options.2.success.tex.context: Event rival_legacy, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

event.rival_legacy.text.default.context: Event rival_legacy, text, faith branch default.

source.text: {rival} was the enemy of the one whose place you have taken. Kin wait to hear whether the old injury belongs to the whole house now — or whether it will be buried with the dead.

event.rival_legacy.title.default.context: Event rival_legacy, title, faith branch default.

source.text: An Inherited Quarrel

event.rival_mediation.options.0.desc.def.context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

event.rival_mediation.options.0.failure..context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: {rival} pushes the purse back. “Silver cannot buy what was taken.” The go-between has no peace to witness.

event.rival_mediation.options.0.label.de.context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Offer fair amends. ({money:10})

source.text: Made peace with a rival through compensation.

event.rival_mediation.options.0.success..context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The purse changes hands. Your enemy names the injury answered, and the witnesses bind you both to peace.

event.rival_mediation.options.1.desc.def.context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Put pride aside and accept an outsider’s terms.

event.rival_mediation.options.1.failure..context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Every term becomes another argument. At last the mediator rises and leaves you to your anger.

event.rival_mediation.options.1.label.de.context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Ask judgment of the mediator.

event.rival_mediation.options.1.success..context: Durable event log for rival_mediation, authored option 1, success.effects.

source.text: Accepted a mediated peace with a rival.

event.rival_mediation.options.1.success..context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: The judgment leaves neither side wholly pleased, which is how the witnesses know it is fair. Both sides swear to let the matter rest.

event.rival_mediation.options.2.desc.def.context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Peace is welcome, but not at the price of surrendering your claim.

event.rival_mediation.options.2.failure..context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: {rival} laughs at the demand. The mediator’s table has merely given the quarrel a new insult.

event.rival_mediation.options.2.label.de.context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Demand that they pay you.

event.rival_mediation.options.2.success..context: Durable event log for rival_mediation, authored option 2, success.effects.

source.text: Took compensation to end a rivalry.

event.rival_mediation.options.2.success..context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: Rather than feed the feud another year, your enemy pays a smaller purse and names the matter closed.

event.rival_mediation.options.3.desc.def.context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Leave with every grievance intact.

event.rival_mediation.options.3.label.de.context: Event rival_mediation, authored option 3, label, branch default.

source.text: There will be no bargain.

event.rival_mediation.text.default.context: Event rival_mediation, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A respected go-between seats you and {rival} beneath the same roof. The terms are old and plain: amends for the injury, witnesses to the promise, and an end to every private revenge.

event.rival_mediation.text.jewish.context: Event rival_mediation, text, faith branch jewish.

event.rival_mediation.text.muslim.context: Event rival_mediation, text, faith branch muslim.

source.text: A respected go-between seats you and {rival} beneath the same roof and urges ṣulḥ: fair amends, named witnesses, and a binding end to the quarrel.

event.rival_mediation.text.pagan.context: Event rival_mediation, text, faith branch pagan.

source.text: An elder seats you and {rival} before the assembly. The terms are old and plain: compensation for the injury, hands clasped before witnesses, and no private revenge.

event.rival_mediation.title.default.context: Event rival_mediation, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Go-Between

event.rival_peace_oath.options.0.label.d.context: Event rival_peace_oath, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Swear the peace.

event.rival_peace_oath.options.1.desc.de.context: Event rival_peace_oath, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

event.rival_peace_oath.options.1.failure.context: Event rival_peace_oath, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

event.rival_peace_oath.options.1.success.context: Event rival_peace_oath, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: The token is yielded without haggling. The witnesses murmur approval, and the oath is made.

event.rival_peace_oath.options.2.desc.de.context: Event rival_peace_oath, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Some injuries deserve a longer memory.

event.rival_peace_oath.options.2.label.d.context: Event rival_peace_oath, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Refuse their hand.

event.rival_peace_oath.text.default.context: Event rival_peace_oath, text, faith branch default.

event.rival_peace_oath.title.default.context: Event rival_peace_oath, title, faith branch default.

event.rival_scheme.options.1.label.defau.context: Event rival_scheme, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.rival_scheme.options.2.label.defau.context: Event rival_scheme, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Repay them in kind.

event.save_the_lord.text.default.context: Event save_the_lord, text, faith branch default.
