event.swarm_in_eaves.options.0.desc.defa.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Sweet gold hangs heavy — and stings.

event.swarm_in_eaves.options.0.failure.t.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The swarm takes offense and then takes flight.

event.swarm_in_eaves.options.0.label.def.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Hive them with smoke and patience.

event.swarm_in_eaves.options.0.success.t.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The queen settles into the basket. By autumn there is honey enough to sell.

event.swarm_in_eaves.options.1.desc.defa.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Shared work, shared honey, stronger friendship.

event.swarm_in_eaves.options.1.label.def.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Ask {friend} to help.

event.swarm_in_eaves.options.2.desc.defa.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: The first sweetness goes to {god}.

event.swarm_in_eaves.options.2.label.def.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Give the first wax and honey to the {temple}.

event.swarm_in_eaves.options.3.desc.defa.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Some gifts are more trouble than honey.

event.swarm_in_eaves.options.3.label.def.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, authored option 3, label, branch default.

source.text: Drive them away.

event.swarm_in_eaves.text.default.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A cloud of bees settles beneath the eaves, heavy with promise and noise. Honey keeps; wax sells; stings swell.

event.swarm_in_eaves.title.default.context: Event swarm_in_eaves, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Swarm in the Eaves

event.sworn_aid.options.0.desc.default.context: Event sworn_aid, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Oaths, it turns out, can be eaten.

event.sworn_aid.options.0.label.default.context: Event sworn_aid, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Take it, and remember.

event.sworn_aid.options.1.desc.default.context: Event sworn_aid, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Pride costs more than coin, and feeds less.

event.sworn_aid.options.1.label.default.context: Event sworn_aid, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Refuse, with thanks.

event.sworn_aid.text.default.context: Event sworn_aid, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Word of your hard times reaches {friend}. The oath you swore was not words only: they arrive with a purse and no speeches.

event.sworn_aid.title.default.context: Event sworn_aid, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Oath Remembered

event.tax_collector.options.0.desc.defau.context: Event tax_collector, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: The ledger closes, and the soldiers move on.

event.tax_collector.options.0.label.defa.context: Event tax_collector, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Pay what is owed.

event.tax_collector.options.1.desc.defau.context: Event tax_collector, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: One goat bleats twice as loud when coin is at stake.

event.tax_collector.options.1.failure.te.context: Event tax_collector, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Bleating betrays you. The fine stings worse than the tax.

event.tax_collector.options.1.label.defa.context: Event tax_collector, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Hide the second goat.

event.tax_collector.options.1.success.te.context: Event tax_collector, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: The ledger records one thin goat. The fat one chews safely in the wood.

event.tax_collector.options.2.desc.defau.context: Event tax_collector, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Empty hands may move him — or merely invite his.

event.tax_collector.options.2.failure.te.context: Event tax_collector, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: He takes your goods in lieu of coin.

event.tax_collector.options.2.label.defa.context: Event tax_collector, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Plead poverty.

event.tax_collector.options.2.success.te.context: Event tax_collector, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: The collector sighs and moves on.

event.tax_collector.text.default.context: Event tax_collector, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The lord’s man arrives with his ledger and his soldiers, tallying hearths and hens alike.

event.tax_collector.title.default.context: Event tax_collector, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Taxman Cometh

event.tend_sick.options.0.desc.default.context: Event tend_sick, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Their gratitude is likely; their fevers are catching.

event.tend_sick.options.0.failure.text.d.context: Event tend_sick, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: You catch what they carry.

event.tend_sick.options.0.label.default.context: Event tend_sick, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Nurse them day and night.

event.tend_sick.options.0.success.text.d.context: Event tend_sick, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Many recover, blessing your name.

event.tend_sick.options.1.desc.default.context: Event tend_sick, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Pious, prudent, and a little hollow.

event.tend_sick.options.1.label.default.context: Event tend_sick, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Pray for them from a safe distance.

event.tend_sick.text.default.context: Event tend_sick, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Fever season fills the infirmary. The sick call for water, for prayers, for their mothers.

event.tend_sick.title.default.context: Event tend_sick, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Infirmary

event.testament_challenge.options.0.desc.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Memory under fire — one slip unravels all.

event.testament_challenge.options.0.fail.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: One phrase slips. The claimant drives a wedge into the uncertainty.

event.testament_challenge.options.0.labe.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Recite the words exactly.

event.testament_challenge.options.0.succ.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Question follows question; the wording never changes. The testament stands.

event.testament_challenge.options.1.desc.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Many tongues, one testament — if they hold.

event.testament_challenge.options.1.fail.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Under pressure, the witnesses remember different gifts.

event.testament_challenge.options.1.labe.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Bring every witness forward.

event.testament_challenge.options.1.succ.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: Too many honest voices agree for the claimant to overcome them.

event.testament_challenge.options.2.desc.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Let the seals answer what grief cannot.

event.testament_challenge.options.2.fail.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: One seal is damaged. Suspicion swallows the rest of the evidence.

event.testament_challenge.options.2.labe.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Break the seal and read the inventory.

event.testament_challenge.options.2.succ.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: Nothing is missing and every mark is witnessed. The division proceeds.

event.testament_challenge.options.3.desc.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Honest doubt costs little; false certainty costs more.

event.testament_challenge.options.3.labe.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 3, label, branch default.

source.text: Admit the proof is uncertain and refer it upward.

event.testament_challenge.options.4.desc.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 4, desc, branch default.

source.text: Pass the quarrel to a higher bench.

event.testament_challenge.options.4.labe.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 4, label, branch default.

source.text: Admit the witnesses are uncertain and refer it upward.

event.testament_challenge.options.5.desc.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 5, desc, branch default.

source.text: Let wiser heads weigh what yours could not.

event.testament_challenge.options.5.labe.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 5, label, branch default.

source.text: Admit the inventory is uncertain and refer it upward.

event.testament_challenge.options.6.desc.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 6, desc, branch default.

source.text: Keep the crooked bargain, and pray no one talks.

event.testament_challenge.options.6.fail.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 6, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Another witness names the bargain aloud. The court turns on you.

event.testament_challenge.options.6.labe.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 6, label, branch default.

source.text: Sell the testimony as promised.

event.testament_challenge.options.6.succ.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 6, success text, branch default.

source.text: Your chosen version becomes the court’s version. The claimant pays well.

event.testament_challenge.options.7.desc.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 7, desc, branch default.

source.text: Lose the coin, keep your soul.

event.testament_challenge.options.7.labe.context: Event testament_challenge, authored option 7, label, branch default.

source.text: Repent and tell the court about the bribe.

event.testament_challenge.text.default.context: Event testament_challenge, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A kinsman rejects the last words and demands the goods. The local court wants something firmer than grief.

event.testament_challenge.title.default.context: Event testament_challenge, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Claimant’s Challenge

event.title_request.options.0.desc.defau.context: Event title_request, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: The liege’s ear is open; his hand is another matter.

event.title_request.options.0.failure.te.context: Event title_request, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: “In time,” says the liege, meaning never. Courtiers hide their smiles.

event.title_request.options.0.label.defa.context: Event title_request, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Make your case.

event.title_request.options.0.success.ef.context: Durable event log for title_request, authored option 0, success.effects.

source.text: Granted a higher title by the liege!

event.title_request.options.0.success.te.context: Event title_request, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The liege nods slowly. “It is earned.” New lands are added to your charge — and a rich gift to the liege’s chest seals the investiture.

event.title_request.text.default.context: Event title_request, text, faith branch default.

source.text: You stand before your liege’s seat and ask, with every courtesy, for greater lands and title.

event.title_request.title.default.context: Event title_request, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Word With the Liege

event.town_elder.options.0.desc.default.context: Event town_elder, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A seat on the bench, if the town will have you.

event.town_elder.options.0.failure.text..context: Event town_elder, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: An older name edges you out. Next time.

event.town_elder.options.0.label.default.context: Event town_elder, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Stand for the council.

event.town_elder.options.0.success.effec.context: Durable event log for town_elder, authored option 0, success.effects.

source.text: Elected to the town council.

event.town_elder.options.0.success.text..context: Event town_elder, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: They raise you to the council bench. Small power, but power.

event.town_elder.options.1.desc.default.context: Event town_elder, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Coin over ceremony.

event.town_elder.options.1.label.default.context: Event town_elder, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Trade needs no title.

event.town_elder.text.default.context: Event town_elder, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The townsfolk mutter that the council needs a man of sense — your name comes up more than once.

event.town_elder.title.default.context: Event town_elder, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Voice in the Town

event.travel_arrival_choice.options.0.de.context: Event travel_arrival_choice, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Time will pass normally, with local work stories while you remain.

event.travel_arrival_choice.options.0.ef.context: Durable event log for travel_arrival_choice, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Began a season of work in {destination}.

event.travel_arrival_choice.options.0.la.context: Event travel_arrival_choice, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Find work and lodging.

event.travel_arrival_choice.text.default.context: Event travel_arrival_choice, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Your purpose in {destination} is complete, but a traveler cannot know a place in a day. You will stay and find local work for at least three months before choosing the road home.

event.travel_arrival_choice.title.defaul.context: Event travel_arrival_choice, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Season in a New Place

event.travel_capstone_pilgrimage.options.context: Event travel_capstone_pilgrimage, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Pray, give thanks, and carry the road’s mark home.

event.travel_capstone_pilgrimage.options.context: Durable event log for travel_capstone_pilgrimage, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Completed a pilgrimage to {destination}.

event.travel_capstone_pilgrimage.options.context: Event travel_capstone_pilgrimage, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Complete the pilgrimage.

event.travel_capstone_pilgrimage.text.de.context: Event travel_capstone_pilgrimage, text, faith branch default.

source.text: After the long road, {destination} stands before you. Dust, fatigue, and all the miles fall quiet at the sacred threshold.

event.travel_capstone_pilgrimage.title.d.context: Event travel_capstone_pilgrimage, title, faith branch default.

source.text: At the Holy Place

event.travel_capstone_service.options.0..context: Event travel_capstone_service, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Earn wages, polish, and useful notice.

event.travel_capstone_service.options.0..context: Durable event log for travel_capstone_service, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Served at the court in {destination}.

event.travel_capstone_service.options.0..context: Event travel_capstone_service, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Take service in the court.

event.travel_capstone_service.options.1..context: Event travel_capstone_service, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Martial service is open only to an eligible man.

event.travel_capstone_service.options.1..context: Durable event log for travel_capstone_service, authored option 1, effects.

source.text: Served in the warband at {destination}.

event.travel_capstone_service.options.1..context: Event travel_capstone_service, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Join the warband.

event.travel_capstone_service.text.defau.context: Event travel_capstone_service, text, faith branch default.

source.text: At {destination}, the court has work for an able outsider. Service in hall and office is open to you; the warband judges by older rules.

event.travel_capstone_service.title.defa.context: Event travel_capstone_service, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Service at a Foreign Court

event.travel_capstone_study.options.0.de.context: Event travel_capstone_study, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Return with a broader and better-trained mind.

event.travel_capstone_study.options.0.ef.context: Durable event log for travel_capstone_study, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Studied with the masters of {destination}.

event.travel_capstone_study.options.0.la.context: Event travel_capstone_study, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Devote yourself to learning.

event.travel_capstone_study.options.1.de.context: Event travel_capstone_study, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Train the skill and experience used in your present career.

event.travel_capstone_study.options.1.ef.context: Durable event log for travel_capstone_study, authored option 1, effects.

source.text: Advanced a profession in {destination}.

event.travel_capstone_study.options.1.la.context: Event travel_capstone_study, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Advance your calling.

event.travel_capstone_study.text.default.context: Event travel_capstone_study, text, faith branch default.

source.text: In {destination}, masters preserve methods and books unknown at home. You may follow learning for its own sake or bring sharper craft back to your profession.

event.travel_capstone_study.title.defaul.context: Event travel_capstone_study, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Lessons Worth the Road

event.travel_capstone_trade.options.0.de.context: Event travel_capstone_trade, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Recover the stake with a modest profit.

event.travel_capstone_trade.options.0.ef.context: Durable event log for travel_capstone_trade, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Closed a cautious venture in {destination}.

event.travel_capstone_trade.options.0.la.context: Event travel_capstone_trade, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Take the cautious return.

event.travel_capstone_trade.options.1.de.context: Event travel_capstone_trade, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Your Stewardship decides whether the venture prospers.

event.travel_capstone_trade.options.1.fa.context: Durable event log for travel_capstone_trade, authored option 1, failure.effects.

source.text: The venture in {destination} barely returned a coin.

event.travel_capstone_trade.options.1.fa.context: Event travel_capstone_trade, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: A hidden fee and a spoiled consignment consume nearly all the stake.

event.travel_capstone_trade.options.1.la.context: Event travel_capstone_trade, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Press the great bargain.

event.travel_capstone_trade.options.1.su.context: Durable event log for travel_capstone_trade, authored option 1, success.effects.

source.text: Won a rich bargain in {destination}.

event.travel_capstone_trade.options.1.su.context: Event travel_capstone_trade, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: Every weight, promise, and delivery falls into place. The venture returns handsomely.

event.travel_capstone_trade.text.default.context: Event travel_capstone_trade, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The markets of {destination} are ready. Your stake can be turned quickly and safely, or risked on the bargain you came all this way to make.

event.travel_capstone_trade.title.defaul.context: Event travel_capstone_trade, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Venture’s Reckoning

event.travel_culture_hospitality.options.context: Event travel_culture_hospitality, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A gift completes the bond.

event.travel_culture_hospitality.options.context: Event travel_culture_hospitality, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Return the courtesy generously.

event.travel_culture_hospitality.options.context: Event travel_culture_hospitality, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Useful hands are welcome in any tongue.

event.travel_culture_hospitality.options.context: Event travel_culture_hospitality, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Offer service in place of coin.

event.travel_culture_hospitality.text.de.context: Event travel_culture_hospitality, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Hospitality in {location} comes with obligations left artfully unspoken. Your host waits to see whether you understand.

event.travel_culture_hospitality.title.d.context: Event travel_culture_hospitality, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Debt of a Welcome

event.travel_culture_language.options.0..context: Event travel_culture_language, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Patience teaches what confidence cannot.

event.travel_culture_language.options.0..context: Event travel_culture_language, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Listen before speaking.

event.travel_culture_language.options.1..context: Event travel_culture_language, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Shared embarrassment becomes shared good humor.

event.travel_culture_language.options.1..context: Event travel_culture_language, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Laugh at the mistake.

event.travel_culture_language.text.defau.context: Event travel_culture_language, text, faith branch default.

source.text: In {location}, a familiar gesture draws blank faces, and your careful words land with quite another meaning.

event.travel_culture_language.title.defa.context: Event travel_culture_language, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Word Mislaid

event.travel_culture_law.options.0.desc..context: Event travel_culture_law, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Adaptation is cheaper than pride.

event.travel_culture_law.options.0.label.context: Event travel_culture_law, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Dress as local custom requires.

event.travel_culture_law.options.1.desc..context: Event travel_culture_law, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: A clear account may carry the day.

event.travel_culture_law.options.1.failu.context: Event travel_culture_law, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The explanation becomes a fine and a long lecture.

event.travel_culture_law.options.1.label.context: Event travel_culture_law, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Explain your true standing.

event.travel_culture_law.options.1.succe.context: Event travel_culture_law, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: The officer accepts the explanation and waves you on.

event.travel_culture_law.text.default.context: Event travel_culture_law, text, faith branch default.

source.text: In {location}, your dress announces a station you do not hold, and a local officer explains the law before someone less patient does.

event.travel_culture_law.title.default.context: Event travel_culture_law, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Cloth, Rank, and Custom

event.travel_culture_table.options.0.des.context: Event travel_culture_table, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Observation keeps offense from the table.

event.travel_culture_table.options.0.lab.context: Event travel_culture_table, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Follow your host’s hands.

event.travel_culture_table.options.1.des.context: Event travel_culture_table, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Courage is sometimes measured by the spoonful.

event.travel_culture_table.options.1.lab.context: Event travel_culture_table, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Taste everything offered.

event.travel_culture_table.text.default.context: Event travel_culture_table, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The food in {location} is served in an order you do not know, under table customs everyone else learned as children.

event.travel_culture_table.title.default.context: Event travel_culture_table, title, faith branch default.

source.text: At a Stranger’s Table

event.travel_culture_weights.options.0.d.context: Event travel_culture_weights, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Stewardship makes a common language.

event.travel_culture_weights.options.0.l.context: Event travel_culture_weights, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Set every measure side by side.

event.travel_culture_weights.options.1.d.context: Event travel_culture_weights, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: A small loss buys useful knowledge.

event.travel_culture_weights.options.1.l.context: Event travel_culture_weights, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Pay for the lesson.

event.travel_culture_weights.text.defaul.context: Event travel_culture_weights, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A merchant in {location} names weights, measures, and a price custom unlike any used at home.

event.travel_culture_weights.title.defau.context: Event travel_culture_weights, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Measure of a Market

event.travel_culture_worship.options.0.d.context: Event travel_culture_worship, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Reverence travels better than certainty.

event.travel_culture_worship.options.0.l.context: Event travel_culture_worship, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Ask the proper observance.

event.travel_culture_worship.options.1.d.context: Event travel_culture_worship, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Respect needs no perfect understanding.

event.travel_culture_worship.options.1.l.context: Event travel_culture_worship, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Withdraw with thanks.

event.travel_culture_worship.text.defaul.context: Event travel_culture_worship, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A threshold in {location} is sacred in ways no one thought to explain. A keeper quietly stops you before you cross it wrongly.

event.travel_culture_worship.title.defau.context: Event travel_culture_worship, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Across a Sacred Boundary

event.travel_patron_gone.options.0.desc..context: Event travel_patron_gone, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: There is no patron left to pay you.

event.travel_patron_gone.options.0.effec.context: Durable event log for travel_patron_gone, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Reached {destination} after its patron was gone.

event.travel_patron_gone.options.0.label.context: Event travel_patron_gone, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Accept what the road has brought.

event.travel_patron_gone.text.default.context: Event travel_patron_gone, text, faith branch default.

source.text: You reach {destination}, but the court that promised service has vanished—conquered, scattered, or moved beyond your reach.

event.travel_patron_gone.title.default.context: Event travel_patron_gone, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Patron Is Gone

event.travel_road_bandits.options.0.desc.context: Event travel_road_bandits, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Cunning against watchful eyes.

event.travel_road_bandits.options.0.fail.context: Event travel_road_bandits, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: They catch you in the thorns and take what they can.

event.travel_road_bandits.options.0.labe.context: Event travel_road_bandits, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Slip away through the brush.

event.travel_road_bandits.options.0.succ.context: Event travel_road_bandits, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Their curses fade behind you while your purse stays put.

event.travel_road_bandits.options.1.desc.context: Event travel_road_bandits, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Better a lighter purse than an early grave.

event.travel_road_bandits.options.1.labe.context: Event travel_road_bandits, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Give up a few coins.

event.travel_road_bandits.text.default.context: Event travel_road_bandits, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Beyond {location}, armed shapes step into the road and ask for your purse with studied politeness.

event.travel_road_bandits.title.default.context: Event travel_road_bandits, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Shapes in the Hedgerow

event.travel_road_illness.options.0.desc.context: Event travel_road_illness, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Bitter herbs and a day beneath blankets.

event.travel_road_illness.options.0.labe.context: Event travel_road_illness, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Rest and drink what the healer gives.

event.travel_road_illness.options.1.desc.context: Event travel_road_illness, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The body may follow where will leads.

event.travel_road_illness.options.1.labe.context: Event travel_road_illness, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Keep moving.

event.travel_road_illness.text.default.context: Event travel_road_illness, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A chill takes hold after leaving {location}. By nightfall, the road sways even when you stand still.

event.travel_road_illness.title.default.context: Event travel_road_illness, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Road Fever

event.travel_road_lodging.options.0.desc.context: Event travel_road_lodging, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Warmth, straw, and a barred door.

event.travel_road_lodging.options.0.labe.context: Event travel_road_lodging, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Pay for the bed. ({money:2})

event.travel_road_lodging.options.1.desc.context: Event travel_road_lodging, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The ditch asks no coin.

event.travel_road_lodging.options.1.labe.context: Event travel_road_lodging, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Sleep beneath your cloak.

event.travel_road_lodging.text.default.context: Event travel_road_lodging, text, faith branch default.

source.text: At {location}, one bed remains beneath a sound roof. The price rises while you stand in the doorway.

event.travel_road_lodging.title.default.context: Event travel_road_lodging, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Last Bed

event.travel_road_toll.options.0.desc.de.context: Event travel_road_toll, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Some arguments cost more than the answer.

event.travel_road_toll.options.0.label.d.context: Event travel_road_toll, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Pay and pass. ({money:2})

event.travel_road_toll.options.1.desc.de.context: Event travel_road_toll, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Accounts and confidence against cudgels.

event.travel_road_toll.options.1.failure.context: Event travel_road_toll, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The toll doubles while the cudgels remain persuasive.

event.travel_road_toll.options.1.label.d.context: Event travel_road_toll, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Question how ancient it is.

event.travel_road_toll.options.1.success.context: Event travel_road_toll, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: Their figures collapse under examination, and so does the toll.

event.travel_road_toll.text.default.context: Event travel_road_toll, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Men with a painted board have stretched a rope across the road near {location}. They call the demand an ancient toll.

event.travel_road_toll.title.default.context: Event travel_road_toll, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Rope Across the Road

event.travel_road_weather.options.0.desc.context: Event travel_road_weather, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A dry night is worth a delayed dawn.

event.travel_road_weather.options.0.labe.context: Event travel_road_weather, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Find shelter and wait it out.

event.travel_road_weather.options.1.desc.context: Event travel_road_weather, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Keep the road, whatever the sky says.

event.travel_road_weather.options.1.labe.context: Event travel_road_weather, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Press through it.

event.travel_road_weather.text.default.context: Event travel_road_weather, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Hard weather closes around the road outside {location}; every rut fills and every mile lengthens.

event.travel_road_weather.title.default.context: Event travel_road_weather, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Weather on the Road

event.travel_work_board.options.0.desc.d.context: Event travel_work_board, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Work hard, keep your distance, and add to the purse.

event.travel_work_board.options.0.label..context: Event travel_work_board, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Take the wage in coin.

event.travel_work_board.options.1.desc.d.context: Event travel_work_board, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Live better and become a familiar face.

event.travel_work_board.options.1.label..context: Event travel_work_board, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Take board and goodwill.

event.travel_work_board.text.default.context: Event travel_work_board, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A household in {destination} needs another pair of hands. The work is ordinary, but so are bread, a dry corner, and being expected tomorrow.

event.travel_work_board.title.default.context: Event travel_work_board, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Board Earned at Dusk

event.travel_work_neighbors.options.0.de.context: Event travel_work_neighbors, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Local habits sharpen your judgment of people.

event.travel_work_neighbors.options.0.la.context: Event travel_work_neighbors, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Learn how things are done here.

event.travel_work_neighbors.options.1.de.context: Event travel_work_neighbors, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Practice your calling and earn a place in the day’s work.

event.travel_work_neighbors.options.1.la.context: Event travel_work_neighbors, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Make yourself useful.

event.travel_work_neighbors.text.default.context: Event travel_work_neighbors, text, faith branch default.

source.text: People in {destination} have begun to greet you before asking who you are. A neighbor offers work that comes with conversation and obligations.

event.travel_work_neighbors.title.defaul.context: Event travel_work_neighbors, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Known in the Lane

event.travel_work_pilgrimage.options.0.d.context: Event travel_work_pilgrimage, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Service keeps the journey’s purpose alive.

event.travel_work_pilgrimage.options.0.l.context: Event travel_work_pilgrimage, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Carry water and tend the weary.

event.travel_work_pilgrimage.options.1.d.context: Event travel_work_pilgrimage, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Order feeds more travelers than good intentions alone.

event.travel_work_pilgrimage.options.1.l.context: Event travel_work_pilgrimage, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Keep the house accounts.

event.travel_work_pilgrimage.text.defaul.context: Event travel_work_pilgrimage, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The pilgrim house in {destination} never lacks for tired feet, empty bowls, and names that must be entered correctly.

event.travel_work_pilgrimage.title.defau.context: Event travel_work_pilgrimage, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Work at the Pilgrim House

event.travel_work_service.options.0.desc.context: Event travel_work_service, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Reliable service earns wages and sharper stewardship.

event.travel_work_service.options.0.labe.context: Event travel_work_service, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Set the stores in order.

event.travel_work_service.options.1.desc.context: Event travel_work_service, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Become known as someone who arrives with the right words.

event.travel_work_service.options.1.labe.context: Event travel_work_service, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Carry messages between households.

event.travel_work_service.text.default.context: Event travel_work_service, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The hall in {destination} has endless work below the notice of great people: stores to count, messages to carry, and disputes to calm.

event.travel_work_service.title.default.context: Event travel_work_service, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Work Beyond the Hall

event.travel_work_study.options.0.desc.d.context: Event travel_work_study, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Slow work fixes the lesson in memory.

event.travel_work_study.options.0.label..context: Event travel_work_study, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Copy the difficult pages.

event.travel_work_study.options.1.desc.d.context: Event travel_work_study, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Teaching pays a little and tests whether you truly understand.

event.travel_work_study.options.1.label..context: Event travel_work_study, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Tutor a younger pupil.

event.travel_work_study.text.default.context: Event travel_work_study, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The masters in {destination} need pages copied, younger pupils corrected, and lamps watched long after respectable people sleep.

event.travel_work_study.title.default.context: Event travel_work_study, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Work Beneath the Lectern

event.travel_work_trade.options.0.desc.d.context: Event travel_work_trade, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Careful work brings a modest return.

event.travel_work_trade.options.0.label..context: Event travel_work_trade, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Take a commission on the delivery.

event.travel_work_trade.options.1.desc.d.context: Event travel_work_trade, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Learn the market rather than merely passing through it.

event.travel_work_trade.options.1.label..context: Event travel_work_trade, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Study every weight and bargain.

event.travel_work_trade.text.default.context: Event travel_work_trade, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A broker in {destination} needs someone who can watch a delivery, remember a promise, and recognize a false weight.

event.travel_work_trade.title.default.context: Event travel_work_trade, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Work Between the Stalls

event.vassal_demand.options.0.desc.defau.context: Event vassal_demand, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A small gift buys a large peace.

event.vassal_demand.options.0.label.defa.context: Event vassal_demand, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Grant a little, graciously.

event.vassal_demand.options.1.desc.defau.context: Event vassal_demand, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: A firm no may cow him — or spur his riders.

event.vassal_demand.options.1.failure.te.context: Event vassal_demand, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: He storms out. Soon his men raid your borderlands.

event.vassal_demand.options.1.label.defa.context: Event vassal_demand, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Refuse him flatly.

event.vassal_demand.options.1.success.te.context: Event vassal_demand, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: He blusters, bows, and yields. The hall takes note.

event.vassal_demand.options.2.desc.defau.context: Event vassal_demand, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Break him before the court, or make an enemy.

event.vassal_demand.options.2.failure.te.context: Event vassal_demand, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: You make an enemy for life, and other vassals mutter.

event.vassal_demand.options.2.label.defa.context: Event vassal_demand, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Refuse — and humiliate him.

event.vassal_demand.options.2.success.te.context: Event vassal_demand, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: Broken before the court, he will never trouble you again.

event.vassal_demand.text.default.context: Event vassal_demand, text, faith branch default.

source.text: One of your sworn men arrives with too many retainers and too few courtesies, demanding lower dues and a seat at your right hand.

event.vassal_demand.title.default.context: Event vassal_demand, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Baron Grows Bold

event.vassal_feud.options.0.desc.default.context: Event vassal_feud, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: One ruling may please both — or neither.

event.vassal_feud.options.0.failure.text.context: Event vassal_feud, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Both hear favoritism in your words. Both leave sulking.

event.vassal_feud.options.0.label.defaul.context: Event vassal_feud, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Judge it yourself, fairly.

event.vassal_feud.options.0.success.text.context: Event vassal_feud, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Your Solomonic ruling pleases both; they leave as uneasy friends.

event.vassal_feud.options.1.desc.default.context: Event vassal_feud, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Unjudged quarrels have a way of spreading.

event.vassal_feud.options.1.label.defaul.context: Event vassal_feud, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Let them tire of it.

event.vassal_feud.text.default.context: Event vassal_feud, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Two of your sworn men feud over a boundary mill — each demands you judge for him, and each watches the other’s face at your board.

event.vassal_feud.title.default.context: Event vassal_feud, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Knives Between Vassals

event.vassal_petition.options.0.desc.def.context: Event vassal_petition, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Generosity now is a shield later.

event.vassal_petition.options.0.label.de.context: Event vassal_petition, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Help him handsomely. ({money:15})

event.vassal_petition.options.1.desc.def.context: Event vassal_petition, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Comfort costs nothing and is valued as such.

event.vassal_petition.options.1.label.de.context: Event vassal_petition, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Good words, empty hands.

event.vassal_petition.text.default.context: Event vassal_petition, text, faith branch default.

source.text: One of your sworn men kneels at your gate: debts press him hard, and only your generosity stands between his family and ruin.

event.vassal_petition.title.default.context: Event vassal_petition, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Vassal’s Suit

event.vassal_revoke.options.0.desc.defau.context: Event vassal_revoke, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Lawful, yes — and he may still say no with spears.

event.vassal_revoke.options.0.failure.te.context: Event vassal_revoke, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: “Come and take it,” he answers, and rides home to raise his spears.

event.vassal_revoke.options.0.label.defa.context: Event vassal_revoke, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Demand the surrender of the fief.

event.vassal_revoke.options.0.success.te.context: Event vassal_revoke, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: He bows stiffly and yields. The court notes your firmness — and his restraint.

event.vassal_revoke.options.1.desc.defau.context: Event vassal_revoke, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: A threat unmade is a war unfought.

event.vassal_revoke.options.1.label.defa.context: Event vassal_revoke, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Think better of it.

event.vassal_revoke.text.default.context: Event vassal_revoke, text, faith branch default.

source.text: You summon {rulername} of {rname} and demand the fief back into your own hand. Such a demand is lawful — but law and gratitude are different things.

event.vassal_revoke.title.default.context: Event vassal_revoke, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Revocation of a Fief

event.vassal_revolt.options.0.desc.defau.context: Event vassal_revolt, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Lose a vassal quietly, keep the rest calm.

event.vassal_revolt.options.0.label.defa.context: Event vassal_revolt, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Let him go in peace.

event.vassal_revolt.options.1.desc.defau.context: Event vassal_revolt, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Broken oaths are answered at sword-point.

event.vassal_revolt.options.1.label.defa.context: Event vassal_revolt, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Answer rebellion with iron.

event.vassal_revolt.text.default.context: Event vassal_revolt, text, faith branch default.

source.text: {rulername} of {rname} sends back your oath-knot in pieces: he will pay no more, kneel no more. His spears are sharpening.

event.vassal_revolt.title.default.context: Event vassal_revolt, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Vassal Renounces You

event.vassal_tax_refusal.options.0.desc..context: Event vassal_tax_refusal, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Dues owed are dues collected, one way or another.

event.vassal_tax_refusal.options.0.label.context: Event vassal_tax_refusal, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Insist on payment, with interest.

event.vassal_tax_refusal.options.1.desc..context: Event vassal_tax_refusal, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Mercy once becomes custom twice.

event.vassal_tax_refusal.options.1.label.context: Event vassal_tax_refusal, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Let it pass — this once.

event.vassal_tax_refusal.text.default.context: Event vassal_tax_refusal, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The season’s tallies come in — and one of your vassals has sent, instead of silver, a letter of excuses as long as your arm.

event.vassal_tax_refusal.title.default.context: Event vassal_tax_refusal, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Empty Chest

event.village_festival.options.0.desc.de.context: Event village_festival, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A day of joy costs little and pays in strength.

event.village_festival.options.0.label.d.context: Event village_festival, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Dance, eat, laugh.

event.village_festival.options.1.desc.de.context: Event village_festival, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Glory or dirt, before the whole village.

event.village_festival.options.1.failure.context: Event village_festival, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: You eat dirt in front of the whole village. They cheer anyway.

event.village_festival.options.1.label.d.context: Event village_festival, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Enter the wrestling.

event.village_festival.options.1.success.context: Event village_festival, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: You pin the miller’s enormous son to roars of delight.

event.village_festival.options.2.desc.de.context: Event village_festival, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Merry throats make heavy purses.

event.village_festival.options.2.label.d.context: Event village_festival, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Sell ale to the merrymakers.

event.village_festival.options.3.desc.de.context: Event village_festival, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Sweet water for sweet coin.

event.village_festival.options.3.label.d.context: Event village_festival, authored option 3, label, branch default.

source.text: Sell sweets and sherbet to the crowd.

event.village_festival.text.default.context: Event village_festival, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Garlands on the well, a lamb on the spit, and the musicians already flushed with cheer. {province} forgets its burdens for a day.

event.village_festival.title.default.context: Event village_festival, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Festival Day

event.visit_city.options.0.desc.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Fortunes turn fast here, in both directions.

event.visit_city.options.0.failure.text..context: Event visit_city, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: A cutpurse thinner than a shadow. You feel the lightness at the gate.

event.visit_city.options.0.label.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Trade in the great market.

event.visit_city.options.0.success.text..context: Event visit_city, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The great market swallows all you brought and asks for more.

event.visit_city.options.1.desc.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The city keeps wisdom for those who ask.

event.visit_city.options.1.label.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Seek out a scholar’s teaching.

event.visit_city.options.2.desc.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: A name in the right ledger opens doors.

event.visit_city.options.2.failure.text..context: Event visit_city, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Stewards and secretaries, all day. The great remain unseen.

event.visit_city.options.2.label.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Petition at the great houses.

event.visit_city.options.2.success.text..context: Event visit_city, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: A door opens; a name is taken down. Doors remember.

event.visit_city.options.3.desc.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Good pay, if harder men don’t want it too.

event.visit_city.options.3.failure.text..context: Event visit_city, authored option 3, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The work went to harder men — after one of them rearranged your face.

event.visit_city.options.3.label.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 3, label, branch default.

source.text: Hire your blade out.

event.visit_city.options.3.success.text..context: Event visit_city, authored option 3, success text, branch default.

source.text: Three nights guarding a nervous silk merchant. The pay is very good.

event.visit_city.options.4.desc.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 4, desc, branch default.

source.text: Stone raised to heaven lifts the heart with it.

event.visit_city.options.4.label.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 4, label, branch default.

source.text: Marvel at the great {temple}.

event.visit_city.options.5.desc.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 5, desc, branch default.

source.text: A city market always has serviceable gear for sale.

event.visit_city.options.5.label.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 5, label, branch default.

source.text: Browse arms and useful goods.

event.visit_city.options.6.desc.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 6, desc, branch default.

source.text: Wine, music, and thinner pockets by morning.

event.visit_city.options.6.label.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 6, label, branch default.

source.text: Wander the pleasure quarter.

event.visit_city.options.7.desc.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 7, desc, branch default.

source.text: Steam soaks the road out of tired bones.

event.visit_city.options.7.label.default.context: Event visit_city, authored option 7, label, branch default.

source.text: Linger in the bath-houses.

event.visit_city.text.default.context: Event visit_city, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Gates like cliffs, streets like rivers. In {settlement} a fortune is made or lost every day, and nobody asks where you were born — only what you carry.

event.visit_city.title.default.context: Event visit_city, title, faith branch default.

source.text: {settlement}

event.visit_town.options.0.desc.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Good coin if the buyers are hungry.

event.visit_town.options.0.failure.text..context: Event visit_town, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: A slow market day. You barely cover the road.

event.visit_town.options.0.label.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Sell at the market.

event.visit_town.options.0.success.text..context: Event visit_town, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: Good prices and quick hands. You come home heavier by a few coins.

event.visit_town.options.1.desc.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Strong backs are sometimes in demand.

event.visit_town.options.1.failure.text..context: Event visit_town, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Too many hands, too little work.

event.visit_town.options.1.label.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Look for paying work.

event.visit_town.options.1.success.text..context: Event visit_town, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: A wall wants mending and a wagon wants loading. Honest coin.

event.visit_town.options.2.desc.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Masters keep the best work for their own.

event.visit_town.options.2.label.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Call at the guild hall.

event.visit_town.options.3.desc.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: A spear is always worth something to someone.

event.visit_town.options.3.failure.text..context: Event visit_town, authored option 3, failure text, branch default.

source.text: No one is hiring swords this season.

event.visit_town.options.3.label.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 3, label, branch default.

source.text: Try the hiring fair.

event.visit_town.options.3.success.text..context: Event visit_town, authored option 3, success text, branch default.

source.text: A merchant train needs spears for the road. Easy duty, fair pay.

event.visit_town.options.4.desc.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 4, desc, branch default.

source.text: An hour of good words costs nothing.

event.visit_town.options.4.label.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 4, label, branch default.

source.text: Hear the {holy} preach at the {temple}.

event.visit_town.options.5.desc.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 5, desc, branch default.

source.text: Useful names are learned over wine.

event.visit_town.options.5.label.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 5, label, branch default.

source.text: Court the town’s notables.

event.visit_town.options.6.desc.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 6, desc, branch default.

source.text: A town market keeps ordinary gear within reach.

event.visit_town.options.6.label.default.context: Event visit_town, authored option 6, label, branch default.

source.text: Browse arms and useful goods.

event.visit_town.text.default.context: Event visit_town, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Market stalls, a smithy’s clangor, and strangers enough that no one stares. {settlement} has walls of a sort, laws of a sort, and coin for those who know their trade.

event.visit_town.title.default.context: Event visit_town, title, faith branch default.

source.text: {settlement}

event.visit_village.options.0.desc.defau.context: Event visit_village, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Small coin, but honest.

event.visit_village.options.0.label.defa.context: Event visit_village, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Trade at the village green.

event.visit_village.options.1.desc.defau.context: Event visit_village, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Gossip is a currency too.

event.visit_village.options.1.label.defa.context: Event visit_village, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Share news at the well.

event.visit_village.options.2.desc.defau.context: Event visit_village, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: A ready ear is a small congregation.

event.visit_village.options.2.label.defa.context: Event visit_village, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Preach to the villagers.

event.visit_village.options.3.desc.defau.context: Event visit_village, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: The smallfolk remember who listened.

event.visit_village.options.3.label.defa.context: Event visit_village, authored option 3, label, branch default.

source.text: Hear the villagers’ grievances.

event.visit_village.options.4.desc.defau.context: Event visit_village, authored option 4, desc, branch default.

source.text: A bench, a cup, an hour’s peace.

event.visit_village.options.4.label.defa.context: Event visit_village, authored option 4, label, branch default.

source.text: Rest at the ale-house. ({money:2})

event.visit_village.options.5.desc.defau.context: Event visit_village, authored option 5, desc, branch default.

source.text: A quiet corner and a full cup.

event.visit_village.options.5.label.defa.context: Event visit_village, authored option 5, label, branch default.

source.text: Rest at the way-house. ({money:2})

event.visit_village.text.default.context: Event visit_village, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Mud lanes, low roofs, and every face turning to mark the newcomer. {settlement} is small enough that nothing here goes unnoticed — including you.

event.visit_village.title.default.context: Event visit_village, title, faith branch default.

source.text: {settlement}

event.wandering_scholar.options.0.desc.d.context: Event wandering_scholar, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Coin for ink may come back as wisdom.

event.wandering_scholar.options.0.label..context: Event wandering_scholar, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Fund his work. ({money:10})

event.wandering_scholar.options.1.desc.d.context: Event wandering_scholar, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Small charity, small return.

event.wandering_scholar.options.1.label..context: Event wandering_scholar, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: A meal and a bed for the night.

event.wandering_scholar.options.2.desc.d.context: Event wandering_scholar, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Books find other roofs.

event.wandering_scholar.options.2.label..context: Event wandering_scholar, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Turn him away.

event.wandering_scholar.text.default.context: Event wandering_scholar, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A traveling scholar — threadbare, sharp-eyed, trailing manuscripts — asks leave to work beneath your roof for a season.

event.wandering_scholar.title.default.context: Event wandering_scholar, title, faith branch default.

source.text: A Scholar Seeks Patronage

event.wandering_skald.options.0.desc.def.context: Event wandering_skald, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A little silver, a lot of the world.

event.wandering_skald.options.0.label.de.context: Event wandering_skald, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Buy him ale for the news.

event.wandering_skald.options.1.desc.def.context: Event wandering_skald, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: A full belly loosens any tongue.

event.wandering_skald.options.1.label.de.context: Event wandering_skald, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Buy him supper for the news.

event.wandering_skald.options.2.desc.def.context: Event wandering_skald, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Songs could carry your name — or bury it in his.

event.wandering_skald.options.2.failure..context: Event wandering_skald, authored option 2, failure text, branch default.

source.text: He improves your story until it is no longer yours, then leaves.

event.wandering_skald.options.2.label.de.context: Event wandering_skald, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Tell him YOUR story.

event.wandering_skald.options.2.success..context: Event wandering_skald, authored option 2, success text, branch default.

source.text: He weaves your deeds into his tale. Your name will travel roads you never will.

event.wandering_skald.text.default.context: Event wandering_skald, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A traveling singer works the crowd by the fire — wars in far lands, kings dead and crowned, and a rumor for every purse.

event.wandering_skald.title.default.context: Event wandering_skald, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The Storyteller

event.war_council.options.0.desc.default.context: Event war_council, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Force a decision in the field — only while they have no host raised. A fielded enemy must be hunted on the map.

event.war_council.options.0.failure.text.context: Event war_council, authored option 0, failure text, branch default.

source.text: The day goes against you. You are carried back with the remnant of your host — alive, and little else.

event.war_council.options.0.label.defaul.context: Event war_council, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Offer pitched battle.

event.war_council.options.0.success.text.context: Event war_council, authored option 0, success text, branch default.

source.text: The lines meet with a sound like a falling forest — and it is theirs that breaks. The field is yours.

event.war_council.options.1.desc.default.context: Event war_council, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: March on their army in the field — battle joins when you catch it.

event.war_council.options.1.label.defaul.context: Event war_council, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Hunt down their field host.

event.war_council.options.2.desc.default.context: Event war_council, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Ladders, mines, and patience — your host must stand in the target province; three seasons of siege take the prize. Beware sorties.

event.war_council.options.2.label.defaul.context: Event war_council, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Press the siege of {target}.

event.war_council.options.3.desc.default.context: Event war_council, authored option 3, desc, branch default.

source.text: Burn and take — weaken them before the next battle.

event.war_council.options.3.failure.text.context: Event war_council, authored option 3, failure text, branch default.

source.text: Their riders were waiting at the ford. Your raiders return fewer, poorer, and ashamed.

event.war_council.options.3.label.defaul.context: Event war_council, authored option 3, label, branch default.

source.text: Harry their lands.

event.war_council.options.3.success.text.context: Event war_council, authored option 3, success text, branch default.

source.text: Granaries burn and herds change owners. Their war grows dearer by the day — and yours a little richer.

event.war_council.options.4.desc.default.context: Event war_council, authored option 4, desc, branch default.

source.text: The host mends and your borders are relieved — but no ground is gained.

event.war_council.options.4.label.defaul.context: Event war_council, authored option 4, label, branch default.

source.text: Fall back and refit.

event.war_council.options.5.desc.default.context: Event war_council, authored option 5, desc, branch default.

source.text: End the war now, at a price.

event.war_council.options.5.label.defaul.context: Event war_council, authored option 5, label, branch default.

source.text: Seek terms.

event.war_council.text.default.context: Event war_council, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Maps, candle-stubs, and hard-eyed captains. The war against {enemy} must be given its next move — and the men must see you certain of it.

event.war_council.title.default.context: Event war_council, title, faith branch default.

source.text: The War Council

event.war_defense_muster.options.2.desc..context: Event war_defense_muster, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Meet them with the host you already have.

event.war_defense_muster.options.2.label.context: Event war_defense_muster, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Stand ready at the border.

event.war_defense_muster.text.default.context: Event war_defense_muster, text, faith branch default.

source.text: {enemy} marches on your lands. Roads fill with carts and rumor; your captains stand in the yard, waiting for orders.

event.war_defense_muster.title.default.context: Event war_defense_muster, title, faith branch default.

source.text: War Comes to You

event.war_deserters.options.0.desc.defau.context: Event war_deserters, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

event.war_deserters.options.0.label.defa.context: Event war_deserters, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Hunt them down and hang one.

event.war_deserters.options.1.desc.defau.context: Event war_deserters, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: The ranks steady.

event.war_deserters.options.1.label.defa.context: Event war_deserters, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Promise double pay at war’s end.

event.war_deserters.options.2.desc.defau.context: Event war_deserters, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: A thin host, but a willing one.

event.war_deserters.options.2.label.defa.context: Event war_deserters, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Let the faint-hearted go.

event.war_deserters.text.default.context: Event war_deserters, text, faith branch default.

event.war_deserters.title.default.context: Event war_deserters, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Empty Bedrolls

event.war_grain_seller.options.0.desc.de.context: Event war_grain_seller, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

event.war_grain_seller.options.0.label.d.context: Event war_grain_seller, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Pay him. ({money:8})

event.war_grain_seller.options.1.desc.de.context: Event war_grain_seller, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Take it by right of hunger — if his guards allow.

event.war_grain_seller.options.1.failure.context: Event war_grain_seller, authored option 1, failure text, branch default.

source.text: His guards were better than his prices. Men are hurt for nothing.

event.war_grain_seller.options.1.label.d.context: Event war_grain_seller, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: “Requisition” the wagons.

event.war_grain_seller.options.1.success.context: Event war_grain_seller, authored option 1, success text, branch default.

source.text: The host eats; the merchant curses your name in three ports.

event.war_grain_seller.options.2.desc.de.context: Event war_grain_seller, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Hunger is cheaper than grain this season.

event.war_grain_seller.options.2.label.d.context: Event war_grain_seller, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: The men can tighten their belts.

event.war_grain_seller.text.default.context: Event war_grain_seller, text, faith branch default.

source.text: A merchant with excellent timing and no shame offers grain enough to keep the host fed — at thrice the honest price.

event.war_grain_seller.title.default.context: Event war_grain_seller, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Grain at Sword-Season Prices

event.war_muster.options.1.label.default.context: Event war_muster, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.war_muster.options.2.desc.default.context: Event war_muster, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: Trust the spears that answered the first call.

event.war_muster.options.2.label.default.context: Event war_muster, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: March with what you have.

source.text: War with {enemy}. The host musters at your banner even now — farmers, spears, and pride. Will you swell its ranks before it marches? And mark this: {target} falls only to a siege — your host must stand upon its walls while the council presses the works.

event.war_muster.title.default.context: Event war_muster, title, faith branch default.

event.war_tribute_offer.options.0.desc.d.context: Event war_tribute_offer, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

event.war_tribute_offer.options.0.effect.context: Durable event log for war_tribute_offer, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Took the enemy’s tribute and ended the war.

event.war_tribute_offer.options.0.label..context: Event war_tribute_offer, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Take the tribute.

event.war_tribute_offer.options.1.desc.d.context: Event war_tribute_offer, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Keep your host standing on {target} and press the siege at each war council — three seasons of works take it.

event.war_tribute_offer.options.1.effect.context: Durable event log for war_tribute_offer, authored option 1, effects.

source.text: Refused tribute; the war goes on.

event.war_tribute_offer.options.1.label..context: Event war_tribute_offer, authored option 1, label, branch default.

event.war_tribute_offer.text.default.context: Event war_tribute_offer, text, faith branch default.

source.text: Beaten in the field again and again, {enemy} sends envoys under a white flag: silver enough to end this war today, if you sheath the sword. But {target} still stands untaken — and its walls will not fall to a purse.

event.war_tribute_offer.title.default.context: Event war_tribute_offer, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Envoys Under a White Flag

event.wardeath_friend.options.0.desc.def.context: Event wardeath_friend, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Hard labor, and a little peace beside it.

event.wardeath_friend.options.0.effects..context: Durable event log for wardeath_friend, authored option 0, effects.

source.text: Buried a friend after battle.

event.wardeath_friend.options.0.label.de.context: Event wardeath_friend, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Dig the grave yourself.

event.wardeath_friend.options.1.desc.def.context: Event wardeath_friend, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: A few coins to drown the picture.

event.wardeath_friend.options.1.label.de.context: Event wardeath_friend, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Drink until the face blurs.

event.wardeath_friend.options.2.desc.def.context: Event wardeath_friend, authored option 2, desc, branch default.

source.text: A cold night’s watch for a warm friend.

event.wardeath_friend.options.2.label.de.context: Event wardeath_friend, authored option 2, label, branch default.

source.text: Keep vigil by the grave until dawn.

event.wardeath_friend.title.default.context: Event wardeath_friend, title, faith branch default.

event.wed_above.options.0.desc.default.context: Event wed_above, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: A favor bought now is peace kept at the high table.

event.wed_above.options.0.label.default.context: Event wed_above, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Oblige them handsomely.

event.wed_above.options.1.desc.default.context: Event wed_above, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: Stand your ground, and let the marriage weather it.

event.wed_above.options.1.label.default.context: Event wed_above, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: You wed {spouse}, not the whole house.

event.wed_above.text.default.context: Event wed_above, text, faith branch default.

source.text: The kin of {spouse} never let you forget the height from which they stooped. Now a cousin writes: the family expects a favor of its new… relation.

event.wed_above.title.default.context: Event wed_above, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Grand In-Laws

event.wed_below.options.0.desc.default.context: Event wed_below, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

source.text: Gossip fades; a good marriage does not.

event.wed_below.options.0.label.default.context: Event wed_below, authored option 0, label, branch default.

source.text: Let them talk. You chose well.

event.wed_below.options.1.desc.default.context: Event wed_below, authored option 1, desc, branch default.

source.text: A little silver buys a little silence.

event.wed_below.options.1.label.default.context: Event wed_below, authored option 1, label, branch default.

source.text: Grease the loudest tongues.

event.wed_below.text.default.context: Event wed_below, text, faith branch default.

source.text: At the well and in the hall they whisper it: you married beneath yourself. {spouse} pretends not to hear.

event.wed_below.title.default.context: Event wed_below, title, faith branch default.

source.text: Tongues Wag

event.wedding_gift.options.0.desc.defaul.context: Event wedding_gift, authored option 0, desc, branch default.

event.wedding_gift.options.0.label.defau.context: Event wedding_gift, authored option 0, label, branch default.

★ classic

★★★ tricky

Bound to the soil, owning nothing — not even yourself. Every step upward must be bought, begged, or bled for.
★★★★★ hardest

Serf
